facts.text: Mama packed us bread and cheese for the trip. I am saving a bit for Papa when I find him.
facts.why: Fievel never says this and it is set in quote marks. It is an invented line. The film's cheese joke is the song line about no cats in America and streets paved with cheese.
facts.fix: Set it as an unquoted note from Fievel about cheese for Papa.

fix_note.text: Saving a bit of cheese for Papa. I will hand it over the minute I find him in New York.

vibe.verdict: Warm family table with food that suits the Mousekewitz story, but it undersells the cheese gag and the songs.
